description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_Resource_Custom' which provides a wrapper implementation for custom resource plugins in the Smarty templating engine. It includes method definitions for fetching templates, retrieving timestamps, populating source objects, and handling template content.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Custom
classes.description: An abstract class extending Smarty_Resource that provides a template for custom resource plugin implementations.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch the template source and modification time from a data source.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Fetches the modification timestamp for a template. Optional to implement; returns null by default.
methods.return: integer|boolean - timestamp or false if not found

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a Smarty_Template_Source object with metadata, including filepath, uid, timestamp, and content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads the template's source content into the source object, throws exception if cannot be loaded.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Determines the basename for the compiled filename from the source object.
